meta.convention: Pauli channel N(rho) = pI rho + pX X rho X + pY Y rho Y + pZ Z rho Z. depolarizing: (1-3p, p, p, p), p is the per-Pauli probability (total error 3p; much of the older literature quotes 3p). two_pauli: (1-2p, p, 0, p). independent_xz: ((1-p)^2, p(1-p), p^2, p(1-p)). Same conventions as arXiv:2605.09138 (code: getDepolKraus, getTwoPKraus, getIndepKraus) and arXiv:2608.15870.
meta.win_rule: IMPROVEMENT: the verifier certifies I_c > 0 (exact/ball arithmetic) for an explicit input at a rational p >= bar. MATCHES_RECORD: certified I_c > 0 at match_from <= p < bar. bar is past the point where the best published state is known (certified or numerically) to have I_c < 0, so a win needs a new state, not a sharper evaluation of a published one.
meta.monotone: depolarizing and independent_xz are semigroups in p (N_p' = M o N_p for p' > p), so I_c > 0 at p gives Q > 0 on [0, p]. two_pauli is not a semigroup under Pauli post-processing: its records (ours and the literature's) are pointwise.
